name: Jamestown Sea Adventure Camp
description_short: One-week sessions at Fort Getty in Jamestown for kids ages 4 to 16. Days are split between sailing, the salt marsh, the rocky shore and touch tanks, and campers don't need any sailing experience.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

refund_policy_summary: All changes and cancellations must be emailed to Contact@JamestownSailing.org. There is a $40 per child cancellation fee. After June 1, money (minus the fee) is refunded only if the camp spot is filled.
